tension: sweetspot-03 showed a flat-then-cliff shape in the code family across reasoning caps (0.833, 0.833, 0.333) but both seats refused it at n=6 per family as indistinguishable from noise. The shape is theoretically motivated -- longer budgets should help until they do not -- yet no arm has tested it at an n that can resolve it. Answering it decides whether an inference-length sweet spot is a citable finding of this project or an artefact of six items.
